data.description: 12 Oct, hardened release build: 1 failure in 6 runs. reads_in_3s_all_allowed was 1, reads_in_3s_one_missing 3. Likely a one-second watch tick already scheduled from the 'Microphone denied' case firing after the switch to all allowed. Not the hardened runtime: no AMFI or library-validation denials in the log. selftest.rs ~1095.
